title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
authors_zh: Dingbang Wu, Rui Hao, Haiyang Wang, Shuzhe Wu, Han Xiao, Zhenghong Li, Bojiang Zhou, Zheng Ju, Zichen Liu, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang
paper_type_zh: 移动 GUI 模拟环境、可验证基准与在线强化学习案例
best_for_zh: 研究移动 GUI agent、环境反馈、RLVR、并行 rollout、sim-to-real 与 verifier 审计的读者
one_line: MobileGym is a browser-hosted mobile GUI simulator whose structured state supports reset/forked rollouts, deterministic state-based judging, and a reported GRPO run.
MobileGym 以可配置、可分叉的结构化 JSON 状态承载移动 GUI episode，并用确定性终局检查同时支持评测与在线 GRPO；其公开物是模拟器、任务和训练代码，而非论文实验的完整 rollout 语料。
why: It exposes mobile post-training as auditable state/action/reward interaction while separating simulated control from real-app fidelity.
inclusion_reason: Direct Track 6 inclusion: the work exposes or specifies an environment-linked data object, action/feedback contract, and auditable construction or evaluation boundary.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mobile GUI-agent research needs more than screenshots and actions: online reinforcement learning requires many replicas of an identical initial state, and reliable evaluation requires a terminal predicate that can inspect changes hidden behind the rendered interface. Real apps make account state difficult to reset or fork, expose only partial state through adb or accessibility APIs, and may cause irreversible messages, transfers, or account changes. MobileGym addresses that infrastructure problem with an Android-like environment implemented in the browser rather than by reproducing proprietary app backends (Paper §§1 and 3.1).

The released research object is a simulator-and-task system, not a fixed trajectory corpus. MobileGym-Bench contains 416 parameterized task templates over 28 simulated apps: 160 train templates and 256 strictly disjoint test templates. At runtime, an instance binds instruction variants and parameters, patches the initial JSON state, lets an agent observe screenshots and issue GUI actions, and records terminal structured state, goal checks, diagnostics, and a scalar reward. The paper states that finite parameter ranges yield more than 27,000 instances, excluding continuous ranges (Paper §§4–4.2).

This belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because the consequential data object is an environment-linked episode: task template and seed, initial-state patch, screenshot/action sequence, final state, programmatic checks, termination status, and reward. It is not an offline demonstration release, a real-device benchmark, or evidence that the simulator reproduces proprietary services or pixel-level Android internals.

The Card reaches L4 content depth through arXiv v2, its appendices, the official project/repository, release and license pages, and current RL code. Its boundary is explicit: experiment rollouts, exact paper-run commit, trained checkpoint, and a complete reward/checkpoint ledger were not verified as released.

移动 GUI agent 研究所需的不只是截图和动作：在线强化学习需要从同一初始状态复制大量环境实例，可靠评测则需要能看到渲染界面背后状态变化的 terminal predicate。真实应用的账户状态难以重置或分叉，adb 或 accessibility API 只能暴露部分状态，发送消息、转账或修改账户还可能产生不可逆后果。MobileGym 用浏览器内实现的 Android-like 环境解决这一基础设施问题，但并不复刻专有应用后端（论文 §1、§3.1）。

公开的研究对象是“模拟器加任务系统”，不是固定轨迹语料。MobileGym-Bench 在 28 个模拟应用上提供 416 个参数化 task template，其中 160 个用于训练、256 个严格不重叠地用于测试。运行时先采样指令变体和参数、向初始 JSON 状态注入 patch，再让 agent 观察截图并执行 GUI 动作，最后记录结构化终局状态、goal checks、诊断项和标量 reward。论文称有限参数空间可产生超过 27,000 个任务实例，尚未计入连续参数范围（论文 §4–§4.2）。

它属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为关键数据对象是与环境绑定的 episode：task template 与 seed、初始状态 patch、截图/动作序列、终局状态、程序化检查、终止状态和 reward。它不是离线 demonstration 发布，也不是真机基准，更不能证明模拟器复现了专有服务或 Android 的像素级内部机制。

本 Card 依据 arXiv v2、附录、官方项目页/仓库、release、许可证和当前 RL 代码达到 L4 内容深度。证据边界仍然明确：未核验到论文实验 rollout、论文运行所用的精确 commit、训练后 checkpoint 或完整 reward/checkpoint ledger 的公开发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MobileGym's central move is to make one structured state representation serve four roles: task initialization, exact reset/fork, deterministic outcome checking, and reward construction. App views are composed from read-mostly world data, a per-environment mutable runtime overlay, and OS runtime state. The agent sees screenshots, while the benchmark layer can read and compare the complete JSON state (Paper §§3.1–3.2, Figures 2–3).

An episode begins with a parameterized natural-language template and a state patch. Its observable behavior is a sequence from a 17-action abstraction, including touch, typing, navigation, waiting, COMPLETE, and ABORT; agent adapters may expose model-native subsets. The evaluator checks goal-specific state through check_goals() or get_answer(), uses typed AnswerSheet fields for query tasks, compares initial and final state for unexpected side effects, and reports Success Rate, Progress Rate, False Complete, Unexpected Side Effects, and Overdue Termination (Paper §§4.2–4.3; Appendices C and F).

The feedback is programmatic but not omniscient. It observes fields represented in simulator state and task-authored checks; it cannot certify real-app backend behavior, pixel fidelity, unmodeled side effects, or semantic correctness outside those checks. The reward called “dense” is denser than binary success because it uses the fraction of passed goal checks, but the paper and current mobilegym_evaluator compute it from completed rollout artifacts. It is therefore an episode-level scalar derived from terminal subchecks, not a per-action stream of intermediate rewards (Paper Appendix G; official mobilegym-rl/cookbooks/mobilegym/evaluator.py).

Relative to AndroidWorld/AndroidLab emulator benchmarks and MobileBench-OL real-device evaluation, MobileGym changes the substrate: browser instances make JSON state cheap to clone and inspect. Relative to AppWorld-style state-based verification, it applies the idea to screenshot-driven mobile interaction and connects the same checks to online GRPO. The directional contribution is a shared environment/feedback interface, not a new policy architecture or a released expert-trajectory dataset.

MobileGym 的核心改动，是让同一套结构化状态同时承担四个角色：任务初始化、精确重置/分叉、确定性结果检查和 reward 构造。应用界面由只读为主的 world data、每个环境独立的可变 runtime overlay 与 OS runtime state 组合而成。Agent 只能看到截图，benchmark 层则可读取和比较完整 JSON 状态（论文 §3.1–§3.2，图 2–3）。

一个 episode 从参数化自然语言模板和 state patch 开始；其行为是 17 类动作抽象中的序列，包括触控、输入、导航、等待、COMPLETE 和 ABORT，不同 agent adapter 可暴露模型原生的动作子集。Evaluator 通过 check_goals() 或 get_answer() 检查任务特定状态，查询任务使用带类型的 AnswerSheet 字段，初终状态全量比较用于发现 unexpected side effects，并输出 Success Rate、Progress Rate、False Complete、Unexpected Side Effects 与 Overdue Termination（论文 §4.2–§4.3；附录 C、F）。

这套反馈是程序化的，但并非全知。它只能观察模拟器状态和任务检查器覆盖的字段，无法证明真实应用后端行为、像素级 fidelity、未建模副作用或检查范围之外的语义正确性。论文所称的 “dense” reward 比二元成功信号更稠密，因为它使用已通过 goal checks 的比例；但论文与当前 mobilegym_evaluator 都是在 rollout 完成后依据 artifacts 计算。因此它是由终局子检查形成的 episode-level 标量，而不是每个动作时刻持续返回的中间奖励流（论文附录 G；官方 mobilegym-rl/cookbooks/mobilegym/evaluator.py）。

与 AndroidWorld/AndroidLab 的 emulator 基准和 MobileBench-OL 的真机评测相比，MobileGym 改变了运行 substrate：浏览器实例使 JSON 状态可低成本复制和检查。与 AppWorld 类 state-based verification 相比，它把这一思路用于截图驱动的移动交互，并将同一检查体系接入在线 GRPO。其方向性贡献是共享的环境/反馈接口，而不是新的 policy 架构或公开的专家轨迹数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and state construction. MobileGym implements 12 everyday-app surrogates and 16 system apps. Read-mostly world data contains entities such as posts and products; mutable runtime overlays contain the current user's profile, carts, drafts, messages, settings, and task-specific overrides; OS runtime stores device and lifecycle state. A task class supplies a natural-language template, parameter samplers, setup/state injection, allowed expected changes, and deterministic goal or answer checks (Paper §§3–4; Appendices A, D, and E).

Instantiation and interaction. The 416 templates are split into 160 train and 256 test templates. Runtime diversity comes from instruction variants, parameter values drawn from curated sets/ranges/current state, and environment configuration. The runner resets the simulator, applies the task state, and forks identical JSON snapshots when grouped rollouts are needed. Agents receive 1080×2400 screenshots, output actions normalized to a 0–1000 coordinate space, and act under 15/30/45/60-step budgets; AnswerSheet tasks receive an additional 15 steps in the paper protocol. The current RL flow runs browser pages through an asynchronous environment pool but adds 10 rather than 15 steps for AnswerSheet tasks, so reproductions must select and pin one protocol (Paper §§4.2–4.3; Appendices C, F, G; official mobilegym_flow.py).

Verification. At termination or truncation, task code evaluates explicit goal checks against initial and final structured state. Query/hybrid tasks may require the agent to fill typed AnswerSheet fields; matchers cover exact choices/text, numeric tolerance, date/time/duration formats, and repeatable fields. Full-state diffing flags mutations outside declared expected changes. The terminal report separates goal success from clean success and records progress, false completion, post-success abort, overdue termination, and unexpected side effects.

Reward and online training. In the reported GRPO case study, Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct is trained on Train160 for 10 steps using 3 RTX Pro 6000 GPUs, 96 browser instances, group size 8, train/PPO mini-batch size 12, per-GPU micro-batch size 2, learning rate 1e-6, KL coefficient 0.01, clipping 0.2/0.28, training temperature 0.7, maximum prompt/response lengths 32,768/1,024, and vLLM asynchronous rollouts (Paper §5.2 and Appendix G). The base reward is terminal goal-check progress p; an incorrect submitted AnswerSheet loses the submission bookkeeping credit, and multiplicative 0.8 or 0.5 discounts apply to unclean success, premature completion, post-success abort, or overdue termination. Binary correctness remains the final success predicate.

Released outputs and reproduction. The repository exposes simulator, task definitions, split lists, runner, judge, trajectory recorder/explorer, and a v0.1.0 online-RL stack built around vendored rLLM and verl. The current launch script defaults to sample_n=1, task_seed=42, group size 8, 96 concurrent tasks, and the train/test splits; its hardware defaults differ from the paper description, so paper results should not be attributed to an unpinned current script. Reproduction must pin arXiv v2, a repository commit or v0.1.0 tag, the data-v0.1.0 archive, Node/Python/browser and dependency versions, split files, task seed/parameter instances, model checkpoint, and all run logs. No canonical corpus of the paper's successful and failed rollouts was verified.

输入与状态构造。 MobileGym 实现 12 个 everyday-app surrogate 和 16 个 system app。只读为主的 world data 保存帖子、商品等实体；可变 runtime overlay 保存当前用户资料、购物车、草稿、消息、设置及任务特定 override；OS runtime 保存设备与生命周期状态。每个 task class 提供自然语言模板、参数采样器、setup/state injection、允许的预期变化以及确定性 goal/answer 检查（论文 §3–§4；附录 A、D、E）。

实例化与交互。 416 个模板拆为 Train160 和 Test256。运行时多样性来自指令变体、从人工整理集合/数值范围/当前状态采样的参数，以及环境配置。Runner 先重置模拟器并应用任务状态；需要 group rollout 时，从相同 JSON snapshot 分叉实例。Agent 接收 1080×2400 截图，在归一化到 0–1000 的坐标空间输出动作，并受 15/30/45/60 步预算限制；论文协议为 AnswerSheet 任务额外增加 15 步。当前 RL flow 通过异步环境池运行浏览器页面，但对 AnswerSheet 只增加 10 步，因此复现者必须选择并固定其中一种协议（论文 §4.2–§4.3；附录 C、F、G；官方 mobilegym_flow.py）。

验证。 Episode 终止或被截断后，task code 依据初始和终局结构化状态计算显式 goal checks。Query/hybrid 任务可能要求 agent 填写 typed AnswerSheet；matcher 覆盖精确选项/文本、数值容差、日期/时间/时长格式和可重复字段。完整 state diff 会标记声明的 expected changes 之外的变更。终局报告区分 goal success 与 clean success，并记录 progress、false completion、post-success abort、overdue termination 和 unexpected side effects。

Reward 与在线训练。 论文的 GRPO 案例在 Train160 上训练 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 10 步，使用 3 张 RTX Pro 6000、96 个浏览器实例、group size 8、train/PPO mini-batch 12、每 GPU micro-batch 2、学习率 1e-6、KL 系数 0.01、clip 0.2/0.28、训练温度 0.7、最大 prompt/response 长度 32,768/1,024，并采用 vLLM 异步 rollout（论文 §5.2、附录 G）。基础 reward 是终局 goal checks 的通过比例 p；提交错误 AnswerSheet 时移除“已提交”记账项的进度，unclean success、提前结束、成功后 ABORT 或 overdue 再乘 0.8/0.5 折扣。报告用二元正确性仍由最终 success predicate 决定。

公开物与复现。 仓库公开模拟器、任务定义、split 列表、runner、judge、trajectory recorder/explorer，以及基于 vendored rLLM 与 verl 的 v0.1.0 在线 RL stack。当前 launch script 默认 sample_n=1、task_seed=42、group size 8、96 个并发任务和 train/test split；其硬件默认值与论文描述并不相同，不能把未固定版本的当前脚本直接等同于论文运行。复现必须固定 arXiv v2、仓库 commit 或 v0.1.0 tag、data-v0.1.0 archive、Node/Python/browser 与依赖版本、split 文件、task seed/参数实例、模型 checkpoint 和全部 run logs。未核验到论文成功/失败 rollout 的 canonical corpus。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the 256-template test split, nine agents span 9.4%–58.8% Success Rate. Gemini 3.1 Pro reports 58.8±1.4 SR and 72.1 PR; Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct reports 9.4±0.6 SR and 20.1 PR. Open-source models use four trials with resampled parameters, while most proprietary rows are single-run; the table marks only Gemini's repeated estimate among proprietary systems. Unexpected Side Effects range from 4.7% to 14.5% and do not decrease monotonically with SR, showing that success and unintended mutation are distinct measurements (Paper Table 2 and §5.1).

The GRPO case study raises Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct from 9.4% to 22.2% SR on Test256, a +12.8-point gain. Difficulty SR changes from 71.2 to 92.5 on L1, 12.3 to 37.7 on L2, 0.6 to 11.7 on L3, and 0.3 to 1.2 on L4. The near-flat L4 result is an important negative boundary: ten training steps did not solve the hardest stratum (Paper §5.2).

For sim-to-real, tasks are first bucketed using four simulator rollouts per base/trained model. Of 67 tasks in the Uplift, Stable-pass, and Mid buckets, eight are excluded because they cannot be equivalently or safely reproduced; 59 are run on a Redmi Note 12 Turbo. On this selected signal subset, simulation rises 33.9%→76.7% (+42.8 points) and real-device execution rises 32.2%→72.9% (+40.7 points), retaining 95.1% of the simulation-side gain. Fifteen sampled Stable-fail tasks score 0/15 for both models on device. This is an author-described existence proof, not comprehensive transfer across the full 256 tasks (Paper Figure 5 and §5.2; Appendix H.5).

Manual audit of 118 signal-subset real-device trajectories finds 12 Qwen3.6-Plus judge errors (10.2%); GPT-5.4 also yields 12 errors on a partially different subset. This supports the paper's motivation for state-based verification inside the simulator, but it does not establish that every authored state checker is correct (Paper §5.2 and Appendix J).

Efficiency measurements report about 400 MB RAM and 50 MB disk per browser instance, about 3 seconds cold start, and a full 256-task evaluation in roughly 6 minutes with 256 parallel instances using about 100 GB RAM and under 10% CPU on the authors' server (Paper Table 1 and §5.3). These system measurements and all performance results are author-reported; this Card did not independently rerun them.

在 256 个测试模板上，九个 agent 的 Success Rate 为 9.4%–58.8%。Gemini 3.1 Pro 报告 58.8±1.4 SR、72.1 PR；Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 为 9.4±0.6 SR、20.1 PR。开源模型使用四次参数重采样 trial，多数闭源模型只有一次运行；闭源行中仅 Gemini 给出重复估计。Unexpected Side Effects 为 4.7%–14.5%，并不随 SR 单调下降，说明成功与非预期状态变更是不同测量对象（论文表 2、§5.1）。

GRPO 案例将 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 在 Test256 上的 SR 从 9.4% 提高到 22.2%，增加 12.8 个百分点。各难度层的 SR 分别从 L1 的 71.2 提高到 92.5、L2 的 12.3 到 37.7、L3 的 0.6 到 11.7、L4 的 0.3 到 1.2。L4 几乎不变是重要负面边界：10 个训练 step 并未解决最难层（论文 §5.2）。

Sim-to-real 实验先根据 base/trained 模型各四次 simulator rollout 对任务分桶。Uplift、Stable-pass 和 Mid 三个 bucket 共 67 个任务，其中 8 个因无法等价或安全复现而排除，剩余 59 个在 Redmi Note 12 Turbo 上执行。在这一筛选后的 signal subset 上，simulation 从 33.9% 升至 76.7%（+42.8 点），真机从 32.2% 升至 72.9%（+40.7 点），即保留 95.1% 的模拟侧增益；另抽样 15 个 Stable-fail 任务，两种模型在真机均为 0/15。作者明确把它视作 existence proof，而不是覆盖完整 256 任务的广泛迁移研究（论文图 5、§5.2；附录 H.5）。

人工审计 118 条 signal-subset 真机轨迹时，Qwen3.6-Plus judge 出现 12 次错误（10.2%）；GPT-5.4 在部分不同的样本上同样出现 12 次错误。这支持模拟器内部采用 state-based verification 的动机，但不能证明每个手写状态检查器都正确（论文 §5.2、附录 J）。

效率测量报告每个浏览器实例约 400 MB 内存、50 MB 磁盘、约 3 秒冷启动；在作者服务器上，256 个并行实例约用 100 GB 内存、CPU 低于 10%，完整 256-task 评测约 6 分钟（论文表 1、§5.3）。这些系统测量和模型结果均为作者报告，本 Card 未独立复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior mobile benchmarks typically trade off fidelity, controllability, and cost. Emulator systems expose screenshots and some programmatic hooks but require gigabytes per instance and cannot readily clone proprietary account/backend state; real-device systems cover actual apps but make reset, safe online RL, and deterministic hidden-state verification difficult. AppWorld demonstrates programmatic state evaluation in a tool-oriented simulated world, while AndroidWorld and AndroidLab supply mobile interaction benchmarks (Paper Related Work and Table 1).

MobileGym's concrete change is to make the mutable mobile world a compact JSON object and use it throughout the pipeline. The same state representation configures an instance, forks identical GRPO group starts, supplies task-specific terminal checks, and supports whole-environment side-effect diffs. Declarative EFSM navigation and modular app contracts are engineering mechanisms that make the simulator analyzable and extensible; AnswerSheet turns query answers into typed GUI state rather than judging free-form model text (Paper §§3–4; Appendices B and F).

For reasoning-data research, the new object is not merely a task prompt or transcript. It is a controllable episode generator whose hidden state and verifier outputs can be serialized beside visual observations and actions. That interface supports online agent RL, evaluation, failure collection, verifier testing, and intentional state-coverage synthesis from the same substrate.

Several components are established rather than novel: browser UI implementation, Playwright action execution, programmatic checks, state-diff testing, GRPO, vLLM rollouts, and shaped scalar reward. The paper's contribution is their mobile-specific integration and scale, plus a limited real-device transfer study. Reusers should verify task-check coverage, app fidelity, split semantics, release pins, and whether the current code reproduces paper-era behavior before attributing gains to the environment design.

既有移动基准通常在 fidelity、可控性与成本之间取舍。Emulator 系统提供截图和部分程序化 hook，但每实例往往需要数 GB 资源，也难以复制专有账户/后端状态；真机系统覆盖真实应用，却难以重置、开展安全在线 RL 或对隐藏状态做确定性验证。AppWorld 在 tool-oriented 模拟世界中展示 programmatic state evaluation，AndroidWorld 与 AndroidLab 则提供移动交互基准（论文 Related Work、表 1）。

MobileGym 的具体改变，是把可变移动世界表示为紧凑 JSON，并贯穿整个 pipeline 使用。同一状态表示可配置任务实例、为 GRPO group 分叉相同起点、执行任务特定终局检查，并做全环境 side-effect diff。Declarative EFSM navigation 与模块化 app contract 是让模拟器可分析、可扩展的工程机制；AnswerSheet 则把 query answer 写成 typed GUI state，而不是评判模型自由文本（论文 §3–§4；附录 B、F）。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，新对象不只是 task prompt 或 transcript，而是一个可控 episode generator：隐藏状态和 verifier 输出可以与视觉 observation、action 一起序列化。同一 substrate 因而可服务于在线 agent RL、评测、失败收集、verifier 测试和按目标状态覆盖生成数据。

其中许多组件并非新发明：浏览器 UI、Playwright 动作执行、程序化检查、state diff、GRPO、vLLM rollout 和 shaped scalar reward 都有既有来源。论文的贡献是面向移动交互的系统集成与并行规模，以及一次有限的真机迁移研究。复用前仍需核验 task-check 覆盖、app fidelity、split 语义、release pin，以及当前代码是否复现论文时期行为，不能把全部增益直接归因于环境设计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Simulator boundary. MobileGym targets interaction fidelity, not proprietary backends or pixel-level Android. Synthetic app state, simplified navigation, missing latency/network/account behavior, or author-modeled UI conventions can make policies exploit simulation regularities that do not transfer. The 59-task device study is selected from simulator signal buckets and excludes eight non-equivalent/unsafe tasks; it is not a representative full-suite transfer estimate (Paper §§3.1 and 5.2).
  • Verifier gaming. Determinism removes stochastic judge variance but not specification error. An agent can maximize authored goal-check coverage while violating an unmodeled user intent, or incur a false negative when a semantically valid state differs from the expected representation. Whole-state diff only detects fields inside the simulator and depends on correct expected_changes; task-authoring documentation itself warns that omitted expected fields cause misleading clean signals (curator inference from the feedback contract and official task spec).
  • “Dense” does not mean stepwise. Reward is the terminal fraction of passed subchecks plus multiplicative discounts, computed after an episode. It supplies more grades than binary success but does not localize which action caused progress. Correlated/easy subchecks can dominate p, and an agent may learn partial-credit shortcuts. AnswerSheet's submission and format requirements may also penalize weak models independently of information retrieval; the paper leaves a same-rollout AnswerSheet ablation to future work (Appendices G and K).
  • Split and contamination. Train160 and Test256 are class/template-disjoint, and Test256 has more cross-app tasks, but no semantic-near-duplicate, pretrained-model exposure, world-data overlap, or downstream benchmark contamination audit is reported. More than 27,000 possible parameter instances do not imply that training saw that many unique states; the current script defaults to one sampled instance per template and repeats identical parameters across epochs unless sample_n changes.
  • Release and replay. The repository can record results, screenshots, model responses, and trajectories, but no immutable corpus of the paper's training/evaluation rollouts, failures, reward vectors, random seeds, or checkpoint was verified. task_seed=42 in the current script pins current sampling behavior, not the paper run unless code and data commits are also fixed. Repository v0.1.0 postdates arXiv v2; current launch defaults differ from the paper hardware description, and current mobilegym_flow.py gives AnswerSheet tasks 10 extra steps where the paper specifies 15. These are concrete version-drift risks.
  • Licensing and scope. Core and RL code are Apache-2.0, while replaceable data/content and simulated assets are CC BY-NC 4.0 with third-party brand/content caveats. Code permission does not imply commercial permission for the companion data. Real-device evaluation also reintroduces manual reset and VLM judging, so simulator verifier reliability should not be projected onto those trajectories.

• 模拟器边界。 MobileGym 追求 interaction fidelity，而不是复刻专有后端或像素级 Android。Synthetic app state、简化导航、缺失的延迟/网络/账户行为或作者建模的 UI 规律，都可能让 policy 利用无法迁移的模拟器特征。59-task 真机研究从 simulator signal bucket 中筛选，并排除 8 个无法等价或安全执行的任务，不能作为完整 suite 的代表性迁移估计（论文 §3.1、§5.2）。
  • Verifier gaming。 确定性消除了随机 judge 方差，却不能消除 specification error。Agent 可能最大化手写 goal checks 的覆盖率，却违背未建模的用户意图；语义有效但状态表示不同也可能被误判。Whole-state diff 只能检测模拟器内的字段，并依赖 expected_changes 正确；官方 task authoring 文档本身也警告，漏列预期字段会产生误导性的 clean 信号（由反馈契约与官方 task spec 推断）。
  • “Dense” 不等于逐步。 Reward 是 episode 结束后计算的终局子检查通过比例，再乘若干折扣。它比二元成功提供更多等级，却不定位是哪一个动作带来进展；相关或容易的子检查可能主导 p，agent 也可能学习 partial-credit shortcut。AnswerSheet 的提交和格式要求还可能独立于信息检索能力惩罚弱模型；论文把同一 rollout 上切换 AnswerSheet 的严格消融留作未来工作（附录 G、K）。
  • Split 与污染。 Train160 与 Test256 在 class/template 层面严格不重叠，Test256 还包含更多 cross-app 任务，但论文没有报告 semantic near-duplicate、预训练模型暴露、world-data overlap 或下游基准污染审计。超过 27,000 个可能参数实例不代表训练实际看到同等数量的独立状态；当前脚本默认每模板只采一个实例，若不改变 sample_n，跨 epoch 会重复同一参数。
  • 公开与 replay。 仓库能够记录结果、截图、模型响应和 trajectory，但未核验到论文训练/评测 rollout、失败、reward vector、随机 seed 或 checkpoint 的不可变语料。当前脚本中的 task_seed=42 只固定当前采样行为；若未同时固定代码与数据 commit，就不能代表论文运行。仓库 v0.1.0 晚于 arXiv v2；当前 launch 默认值与论文硬件描述不同，当前 mobilegym_flow.py 还为 AnswerSheet 增加 10 步、而论文规定 15 步。这些都是具体的版本漂移风险。
  • 许可证与适用范围。 Core/RL code 为 Apache-2.0，可替换数据、内容和模拟资产为 CC BY-NC 4.0，并带第三方品牌/内容 caveat。代码许可不等于 companion data 可商用。真机评测又引入人工重置与 VLM judging，不能把模拟器 verifier 的可靠性直接外推到这些轨迹。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, MobileGym is a concrete blueprint for producing replayable-by-construction episodes: pin a template and sampled parameters, serialize the initial JSON state, record screenshot/action/model-response steps, retain final state and every goal-check result, and store termination and side-effect diagnostics. Researchers can use the released recorder/explorer to collect both successes and failures rather than exporting only positive transcripts.

For online agent training, the useful baseline is not a prepackaged rollout dataset but an environment-plus-reward recipe. Reproduce Train160 sampling, fork identical states for each GRPO group, compare binary success against terminal progress reward, and ablate the unclean/false-complete/overdue discounts. Because the reward is terminal subcheck density rather than action-level process supervision, a proper study should log subcheck correlations and test reward gaming before calling it process feedback.

For evaluation and verifier research, Test256 supports separate reporting of SR, PR, FC, OT, and USE. Useful audits include mutation tests for every check_goals, adversarial states that satisfy fields without user intent, alternate-valid-state tests, expected_changes coverage, seed stability, and AnswerSheet format sensitivity. The paper's VLM-judge error set motivates comparing code predicates with independently audited labels rather than assuming programmatic checks are ground truth.

For sim-to-real work, use the 59-task study as a protocol seed: declare task-selection buckets, list excluded unsafe/non-equivalent tasks, preserve simulator and device rollouts, and report absolute base/trained results in both environments. Do not summarize only the 95.1% retained-gain ratio.

Reuse class: suitable as a pinned environment, evaluation surface, and online-RL recipe; training reuse means generating new rollouts under a fixed release, not downloading the paper's rollout corpus. Companion data/content are non-commercial, and claims tied to paper results remain blocked until the exact run commit, rollout ledger, and checkpoint are available.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data，MobileGym 给出一种“生成时即具备 replay 条件”的 episode 蓝图：固定 template 和采样参数，序列化初始 JSON 状态，记录 screenshot/action/model-response step，保留终局状态与每个 goal-check 结果，并保存终止和 side-effect 诊断。研究者可用公开 recorder/explorer 同时收集成功与失败，而不是只导出正例 transcript。

对在线 agent training，可复用 baseline 不是预打包 rollout 数据集，而是“环境加 reward”配方：复现 Train160 采样，为每个 GRPO group 分叉相同状态，对照二元成功与终局 progress reward，并消融 unclean/false-complete/overdue 折扣。由于这里的 reward 是终局子检查密度而非 action-level process supervision，严谨实验应记录子检查相关性并测试 reward gaming，再决定是否把它称为过程反馈。

对评测与 verifier 研究，Test256 可分别报告 SR、PR、FC、OT 和 USE。可执行审计包括：对每个 check_goals 做 mutation test，构造满足字段但违背用户意图的对抗状态，检查 alternate-valid state、expected_changes 覆盖、seed 稳定性和 AnswerSheet 格式敏感性。论文的 VLM-judge 错误集说明，应把 code predicate 与独立人工标签比较，而不是默认程序化检查即为 ground truth。

对 sim-to-real，可把 59-task 研究用作协议起点：声明 task-selection bucket，列出被排除的不安全/不等价任务，同时保存 simulator 与 device rollout，并在两个环境分别报告 base/trained 绝对结果。不能只概括为 95.1% retained-gain ratio。

复用等级：适合作为固定版本的环境、评测面和在线 RL recipe；所谓训练复用，是在固定 release 下生成新 rollout，而不是下载论文 rollout corpus。Companion data/content 限于非商业使用；与论文结果直接关联的复现主张，在精确 run commit、rollout ledger 和 checkpoint 公布前仍受阻。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Figures 2–3 and §§3–4: the key object is the JSON-state episode generator, not the leaderboard.
  • Read Appendix G before interpreting “dense reward”: it is terminal goal-check progress with discounts, not a per-action reward trace.
  • Keep the two gains separate: +12.8 SR points on full Test256 versus +42.8 simulation and +40.7 real-device points on the selected 59-task signal subset.
  • Treat Train160/Test256 as template-level disjointness; semantic overlap, world-data overlap, and pretraining contamination remain unknown.
  • Pair this with AndroidWorld/AndroidLab for emulator contrasts and AppWorld for state-based verification; inspect current mobilegym-rl separately because v0.1.0 postdates arXiv v2.
  • Still needed: exact paper-run commit/data pin, sampled task IDs and seeds, complete success/failure rollout logs, reward vectors, and the trained checkpoint.

• 先读图 2–3 与 §3–§4：核心对象是基于 JSON state 的 episode generator，而不是 leaderboard。
  • 解释 “dense reward” 前先看附录 G：它是终局 goal-check progress 加折扣，不是逐动作 reward trace。
  • 区分两组增益：完整 Test256 上 +12.8 个 SR 点；筛选后的 59-task signal subset 上，simulation +42.8 点、真机 +40.7 点。
  • Train160/Test256 只应理解为 template-level disjointness；semantic overlap、world-data overlap 与预训练污染仍未知。
  • 可与 AndroidWorld/AndroidLab 对照 emulator 路线，与 AppWorld 对照 state-based verification；当前 mobilegym-rl 需单独审计，因为 v0.1.0 晚于 arXiv v2。
  • 仍需公开：论文运行的精确 commit/data pin、采样 task ID 与 seed、完整成功/失败 rollout log、reward vector 和训练后 checkpoint。
